title: Prepare chat messages
summary: A chat prompt can prepare messages with roles. A system message sets application guidance, while a human message carries a user request.
introduction: A chat prompt can prepare messages with roles. A system message sets application guidance, while a human message carries a user request. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A chat prompt can prepare messages with roles. A system message sets application guidance, while a human message carries a user request.

blocks.code:
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([("system", "Use short clear sentences."), ("human", "Explain {topic}.")])
messages = prompt.invoke({"topic": "a loop"}).to_messages()
print([message.type for message in messages])
blocks.title: Prepare chat messages

blocks.text: The output is ['system', 'human']. Two message objects were prepared. No model received them in this code.
